viewing_check: Measure thickness (the biggest value driver), width and length. Check the centre split at the bottom, end checks, spalting or rot, and whether it is kiln dried or green. Wide, thick, sound slabs have reached $110 to $125; thin or checked ones sell at $15 to $50.
